**HMG-API 1.1.0**, the mod manager for Hyundai, Kia and Genesis Gen5W navigation head units. It's 1.1.0-rc.10's code, after a beta and ten release candidates. If you're on rc.10, the update only changes the version.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is the last HMG-API release checked with NEMESIS.** It was tested with NEMESIS 1.17.1 on a car. HMG-API is separating from NEMESIS ([Discussion #444](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/discussions/444)): later HMG-API releases won't be checked against NEMESIS, and NEMESIS releases after 1.17.1 haven't been checked with this one. #444 has the advice for units with both installed.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0)**, **ADB [1.0.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1)**, and NEMESIS in the app menu.

**Tested on:** TODO (car, region, head unit software, NEMESIS 1.17.1).

## What's new since 1.0.2

### Cars

- **Hook maps for many more cars:** most US and Canadian Hyundai and Kia builds on their newest software (260507, 260903, 260206), the Korean Kia and Ioniq 5 builds (260902), and more from your Car Reports. The list is on [Supported cars](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Supported-cars).
- **A car with no map maps itself** from its own files, and the points a map lacks are mapped on the car.
- **The Wi-Fi hotspot on cars that don't have one** (Korean units, the older US Hyundai and Kia builds): HMG-API turns it on for a mod that asks.
- **HMG-API brings up the Wi-Fi network wireless CarPlay and Android Auto join**, from boot and after QuickBoot, on cars whose own apps don't start it.

### Installing and keeping the car safe

- **Cleaner install and uninstall:** after a firmware update, when a mod's file is gone, and with the boot scripts given back exactly as they were.
- **`app_process` is checked every time:** HMG-API only ever keeps a real stock binary as its stock copy, and refuses an `app_process` it doesn't know, with nothing changed. A new test runs the install and uninstall through every order of installs, uninstalls, restarts, NEMESIS installs and removals, firmware reinstalls and factory resets.
- **NEMESIS 1.17's LivePatch:** HMG-API installs and uninstalls under it, and repairs units an older release installed over NEMESIS's script (#397).
- **The boot guard no longer turns hooks off after quick restarts**, and there's no restart loop after a failed rollback.
- **The app says when over-the-air updates aren't blocked.**

### For owners

- **Record a problem:** a log to send to whoever is helping you, with nothing personal in it.
- **Home Wi-Fi while the car is off**, for mods. Mods never use the car's mobile data, DNS lookups included.
- **"Install anyway" covers a mod's patch sets too**, and installing a mod from Updates no longer stops with a `.xml.tmp` rename error.
- **More mods in the catalogue**, and "Support the project" in Settings.

### For mod authors

- Car events, the `parked` reading, new hook points, settings that save themselves, and vehicle readings that answer at once. [`docs/mod-reference.md`](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0/docs/mod-reference.md) has the details, and the mod SDK is `hmgapi-mod-sdk-1.1.0.zip`.

The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta or an RC:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Restart the head unit once afterwards. Your mods and settings stay. Update the bundled mods from the same stick.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** follow [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-usb.zip`.

## Known issues

- Bluetooth Audio can take audio focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up. A fix is in review (wireless #56).
- A USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting, so take the stick out after installing.
- If the install or uninstall says your `app_process` "isn't a known stock build," nothing was changed. Please [open an issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with the line from `HMGAPI/install.log` on the stick (or `/data/hmgapi/install.log`), your car and its head unit software. We check that build and add it.

## Going back to 1.0.2

**Not on NEMESIS 1.17:** 1.0.2's installer and uninstaller don't know LivePatch, and its uninstall there can leave Android unable to start.

Otherwise, [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) is the release to go back to. The app won't install an older HMG-API over a newer one, so either:
- **With adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **Without adb:** uninstall HMG-API ([Uninstalling](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Uninstalling), without `PURGE`, so your mods and settings stay), restart, then install 1.0.2 as new.

Wireless 2.2.0 needs HMG-API 1.1.0, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too: remove the mod in the app and apply, then install `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from 1.0.2's release with **Check USB updates**.

## Reporting

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version, your NEMESIS version if you have it, and your mods. Add a Car Report if you can.
